assignment.title: Transactional outbox replay
assignment.required_executable_output: Outbox processor, duplicate/lost callback fixtures, and tests.
delivered_executable_output: outbox_processor.py: append-only framed journal, inbox deduplication, transactional outbox, idempotent effect sink, lease fencing, monotonic checkpoints and a recovery scanner.
fixtures/sanitized-workload.json: 3 sanitized repository-native custody tasks and 38 callbacks.
replay_harness.py, verify_replay.py, compile_artifact_manifest.py and 165 focused automated tests.

method.durable_state: One append-only CRC-framed journal per store is the only durable state; every projection is rebuilt by replaying frames from byte zero, so no crash can leave a snapshot disagreeing with the log.
method.atomicity: An admitted callback commits its task transition and its outbox enqueue inside a single journal frame, so a transition can never exist without its queued effect and an effect can never exist without its authorising transition.
method.deduplication: delivery_id is the idempotency key over a canonical digest of every other field. An identical redelivery is suppressed without appending; a differing payload under the same id is IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT.
method.refusal_classes: STATE_MISMATCH and FUTURE_FENCE are retriable and do not claim the delivery id; the other twelve refusal codes are terminal and claim it permanently.
method.exactly_once_effects: External effects pass through a sink that is idempotent on effect_key and is applied before the journal records the dispatch, so a crash between the two replays as ALREADY_APPLIED. One sink record per key means one external effect.
method.fencing: A lease transfer bumps the fence by exactly one and rebinds the producer; a displaced worker offering the old fence is refused with STALE_FENCE.
method.recovery: A torn tail frame is detected by its length and CRC header, truncated, and recorded once. The scanner reports pending effects, uncommitted tasks and uncommitted provider completions, and is idempotent.
method.custody_guards: Only a coordinator may record COMPLETED, a producer may not review its own result, RESULT_COMMITTED requires an external effect, and provider COMPLETED without a durable commit derives PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED.
method.fault_injection: Faults are armed at eight named durability boundaries; a tripped phase loses all in-memory state and the next phase reopens the store from bytes on disk.
method.determinism: No wall-clock, path, process id or environment value enters any record or report, so the compiled report is byte-identical across runs, machines and clean clones.
method.sanitized_workload: Task ids, roles and effect keys mirror the PO-03 commission lifecycle; an automated test asserts the workload carries no external-surface key, no '://', no '@' and no PO-01 path.

metrics_notes.first_pass_outcome: The first compiled harness run found one real mechanism gap (a redelivered malformed callback appended an unbounded run of identical rejection records) and one test-helper defect (a state-advance helper replayed already-committed steps). Both were found by this unit's own tests before any commit, both were repaired, and the committed run is green. No defect escaped to the commit.
metrics_notes.observed_local_work_window_seconds: Producer-observed session window at minute resolution, not the controller dispatch clock.
metrics_notes.recovery_events: Twelve injected crashes, each followed by a durable-journal replay that converged without a duplicate transition or a duplicate external effect.
